name: Sunrise Hike at Mutianyu Great Wall
description: Beat the crowds by arriving early to hike the restored, forest-covered ridges of the Mutianyu section. You will experience the sheer scale of the Ming Dynasty fortifications and can take a thrilling toboggan ride down from the wall for a unique perspective.
duration_note: Advance booking via official WeChat mini-program recommended. Requires moderate physical fitness.

name: Forbidden City Imperial Tour
description: Walk through the heart of the Ming and Qing dynasties in the world's largest palace complex. You will explore grand halls, intimate courtyards, and hidden gardens that housed 24 emperors.
duration_note: Strict advance booking (7 days prior) via official platform is mandatory. Passport required.

name: Hutong Rickshaw and Home Visit
description: Ride a traditional rickshaw through the narrow, ancient alleyways of old Beijing. You will visit a local family in a traditional courtyard home to learn about daily life and neighborhood history.

name: Authentic Peking Duck Banquet at Siji Minfu
description: Experience the legendary craft of roasting Peking duck over fruit-tree wood. You will learn to wrap the crispy, golden skin and succulent meat in thin pancakes with hoisin sauce, cucumber, and leek.
duration_note: Expect long wait times during peak hours.

name: Jazz Night at East Shore Jazz Cafe
description: Relax at this intimate venue overlooking the serene Houhai Lake in the heart of the historic hutongs. You will enjoy live performances from top-tier local and international jazz musicians.

name: Temple of Heaven Tai Chi Session
description: Join local practitioners for a morning Tai Chi class in the gardens of the Temple of Heaven. You will learn foundational movements while surrounded by traditional imperial architecture and cypress trees.
duration_note: Best from 7 AM to 9 AM.

name: Bund Skyline & Puxi Heritage Walk
description: Contrast the futuristic skyscrapers of Pudong with the neoclassical stone facades of the Bund. You will walk along the Huangpu River promenade to witness one of the world's most dramatic architectural intersections.

name: Humble Administrator's Garden Stroll
description: Immerse yourself in the pinnacle of classical Chinese garden design, featuring complex rockeries, lotus-filled ponds, and elegant pavilions. You will discover the quiet philosophy of Ming-era aesthetics.
duration_note: Early morning visit recommended.

name: Shanghai Museum Bronze and Ceramic Art Tour
description: Explore one of China's finest museums, home to thousands of ancient artifacts. You will wander through galleries of intricate bronzeware, calligraphy, and delicate porcelain spanning 5,000 years.
duration_note: Entry is free but requires reservation online.

name: Xiao Long Bao Tasting at Din Tai Fung
description: Savor the world-renowned soup dumplings, crafted with precisely 18 pleats. You will watch chefs through the glass display as they hand-make these delicate parcels filled with steaming pork broth.

name: Speakeasy Drinks at Speak Low
description: Navigate through a hidden door in a bartending supply shop to access this multi-level craft cocktail bar. You will discover unique infusions inspired by local ingredients.
duration_note: Advance reservation recommended.

name: Maglev Train High-Speed Experience
description: Experience the world's fastest commercial magnetic levitation train connecting the airport to the city. You will reach speeds of over 430 km/h, feeling the sheer force of modern Chinese engineering.

name: Panda Keeper Experience at Dujiangyan
description: Work alongside professional keepers to feed and care for the giant pandas in a conservation setting. You will gain rare, close-up access to these iconic animals while learning about vital habitat protection.
duration_note: Must book weeks in advance; strictly limited spots.

name: Potala Palace Spiritual Pilgrimage
description: Ascend to the former winter palace of the Dalai Lamas, perched dramatically over the Lhasa Valley. You will explore thousands of prayer rooms, thangka paintings, and ancient relics.
duration_note: Tibet Travel Permit and guide mandatory. High altitude requires acclimatization.

name: Spicy Hot Pot Challenge at Shu Da Xia
description: Test your palate with the numbing, fiery experience of a traditional Chengdu hot pot. You will cook fresh meats in a bubbling cauldron of Sichuan peppercorns and chili oil.

name: Hot Spring Soak at Dali Cloud Spa
description: Relax in mineral-rich geothermal baths with sweeping views of Erhai Lake. You will enjoy the therapeutic benefits of the water while surrounded by high-altitude natural beauty.

name: Namtso Lake High Altitude Trek
description: Traverse the pristine, turquoise waters of Namtso Lake, one of the highest saltwater lakes on earth. You will experience the stark beauty of the Tibetan plateau and nomadic herder culture.
duration_note: Requires Tibet Travel Permit. Serious altitude fitness required.

name: Terracotta Warriors Archaeology Tour
description: Descend into the vast pits housing the thousands of life-sized, unique clay soldiers protecting the First Emperor's tomb. You will learn the history of the Qin dynasty.
duration_note: Passport required for ticket purchase.

name: Glass Skywalk at Tianmen Mountain
description: Walk across a transparent glass cliff-hanging path 4,700 feet above the ground. You will experience a massive adrenaline rush while looking straight down at the vertical drop.
duration_note: Requires advance booking; weather dependent.

name: Muslim Quarter Street Food Crawl
description: Navigate the bustling, aromatic lanes of the Muslim Quarter to sample Roujiamo and Yangrou Paomo. You will experience a unique fusion of Silk Road flavors.

name: Bailong Elevator Ascent
description: Ascend the world's tallest outdoor elevator built into the side of a massive sandstone pillar. You will see the inspiration for the Hallelujah Mountains from the film Avatar.

name: Bamboo Rafting on the Yulong River
description: Glide down the tranquil, jade-colored Yulong River on a traditional bamboo raft. You will drift past ancient bridges, water buffalo, and the iconic limestone karst peaks.
duration_note: Check for high-water seasonal closures.

name: Morning Yum Cha at Guangzhou Restaurant
description: Participate in the classic Cantonese morning ritual of Yum Cha. You will feast on Har Gow, Char Siu Bao, and Phoenix Talons in a grand hall filled with local families.
duration_note: Arrive before 9:00 AM.

name: Canton Tower Night Observation
description: Ascend one of the world's tallest television towers to see the Pearl River Delta illuminated at night. You will get a 360-degree panoramic view.

name: West Street Bar Crawl
description: Explore the vibrant, neon-lit alleyways of West Street. You will find a blend of craft beer dens, live rock bars, and fusion cafes packed with international travelers.

name: Reed Flute Cave Light Show
description: Explore an extensive limestone cave system illuminated with multi-colored lights. You will see incredible stalactites, stalagmites, and rock formations that have formed over millions of years.
